source.name: Philadelphia Union, 'Philadelphia Union Unveil New 2026 Primary “1776 Kit”'
source.quote: Bimbo once again returns to the jersey as the front-of-kit sponsor.
source.note: Bimbo Bakeries USA brand Bimbo on the primary kit; Thomas' (same company) on the secondary kit. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey sponsor survey confirms the split: https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/

source.name: Philadelphia Union, 'Philadelphia Union Unveil New 2026 Primary “1776 Kit”'
source.quote: Independence Blue Cross’ (IBX) logo returns to the right sleeve of the Union’s primary, secondary, and specialty jersey’s worn during league competition
source.note: Right sleeve; on the shirt since 2024 (club sleeve-patch announcement: https://www.philadelphiaunion.com/news/philadelphia-union-independence-blue-cross-renew-partnership-sleeve-patch). For Soccer's 2026 survey confirms IBX on the right sleeve: https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/

source.name: FOR SOCCER
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: Left sleeve, league-wide MLS patch; the survey's Philadelphia Union row confirms Apple TV left, Independence Blue Cross right.

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Bimbo fronts the jersey, with Independence Blue Cross (IBX) on the right sleeve.
